title: Fleet data layer + carrier list page with create/edit form
description: Scaffold the fleet feature module in dispatch-ui. Define TypeScript interfaces for all fleet entities (Carrier, Driver, Vehicle, Contact, TruckExpense). Create carrier API client functions using axiosInstance. Set up Redux carrier entity module using createEntityModule from @mocho/ui/redux. Register carrier entities in the root store (reducer + saga). Create fleet routes scaffold with all fleet page paths. Build the carrier list page with DataGrid (using existing DataGrid + ActionsCell from @mocho/ui) and carrier create/edit FormDialog. Add Fleet nav group to sidebar (Carriers, Drivers, Vehicles under Fleet + Contacts as separate item). CONCERNS.md notes dispatch-ui has no tests yet — include at least one test file to establish the pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript interfaces defined in src/pages/fleet/types.ts: Carrier, CreateCarrierInput, UpdateCarrierInput, Driver, Vehicle, TruckExpense, Contact with all fields matching Prisma schema

Carrier API functions in src/pages/fleet/api/carrierApi.ts: getCarriers(params), getCarrier(id), createCarrier(data), updateCarrier(id, data), deleteCarrier(id), getCarrierOnboarding(id) — all using axiosInstance
Redux carrier entity module created using createEntityModule from @mocho/ui/redux with standard CRUD operations (fetchAll, fetchById, create, update, delete)
Carrier entity registered in store: entities.carriers in rootReducer, carrier sagas in rootSaga

CarrierListPage renders DataGrid with columns: name (clickable link to detail), type badge (COMPANY_ASSET green / EXTERNAL_CARRIER blue), MC#, status, onboarding status (Complete chip green / Incomplete chip orange for external carriers), driverCount, vehicleCount, actions (view/edit/delete)
DataGrid supports server-side pagination (page/limit params), search input with debounce, type filter dropdown (All/Company Asset/External Carrier)

CarrierFormDialog uses Formik + Yup: name (required), type (select: Company Asset, External Carrier), mcNumber, dotNumber, phone, email, address/city/state/zip, dispatchFeePercent, partnerSplitPercent, feeIncludesAccessorials toggle, onboarding boolean toggles (dispatchAgreement, insuranceCert, w9, carrierPacket), insuranceExpiry date picker
Delete uses ConfirmDeleteDialog from @mocho/ui; shows blocking load list on 409 error
Fleet nav group added to sidebar: Fleet (parent) > Carriers, Drivers, Vehicles; Contacts as separate top-level item
At least one test: CarrierListPage.test.tsx renders page title and DataGrid using renderWithTheme pattern
All styling uses MUI sx prop; no CSS modules or styled-components
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
